title: Kashmir
tagline: Paradise on earth, at a gentler pace
description: Few places live up to their legend like Kashmir. Mornings begin with mist lifting off Dal Lake as flower sellers glide past in shikaras; afternoons drift through Mughal gardens laid out four centuries ago; evenings end with saffron kahwa on the deck of a carved cedar houseboat.

Beyond Srinagar, the valley opens into three very different worlds — the alpine meadows and gondola of Gulmarg, the river-carved pine valleys of Pahalgam, and the glacier-fed 'meadow of gold' at Sonmarg. We pace every itinerary so you see the highlights without spending your holiday in a car.

highlights.title: Dal Lake & houseboats
highlights.text: Sleep aboard a hand-carved cedar houseboat and glide past floating gardens at sunrise.

highlights.title: Gulmarg Gondola
highlights.text: Ride one of the world's highest cable cars to Apharwat Peak at nearly 4,000 m.

highlights.title: Pahalgam valleys
highlights.text: Wander Betaab and Aru valleys — pine forests, rushing rivers and wide-open meadows.

highlights.title: Sonmarg glaciers
highlights.text: Trek or ride a pony to the Thajiwas Glacier, snowy even in high summer.
